QuestInfo.name: Truth in Lies
QuestInfo.1: You have to defeat the #r#o8230073:##k. It appeared out of nowhere! But, you didn't eat the neutralizer. What's going to happen to you?

And the more you investigate, the more it seems nothing here is real.\r\nAt least Eight has decided you're a friend. You'll have to do some more investigating.
QuestInfo.0: It's time to brew up the Potion of Truth with some #r#p2560100:##k.
